data.long_meaning: Itika is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'itih' which means 'that which is'. It is a name given to a girl, signifying divinity, purity, and the essence of the universe. The name is rich in spiritual meaning, symbolizing wisdom, self-realization, and inner peace. The name Itika carries the meaning “Divine, Pure” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Itika usually hope their child will grow to embody divine, pure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
